headline: MIA @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.58 at STL 4.26, with a projected total of 8.84. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +0.36 runs while STL moved +0.04, changing the projected margin by +0.32 runs. The projected total climbed +0.41, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -18.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Andre Pallante has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Lars Nootbaar, Masyn Winn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
